videos.title: 01 - POS Checkout & Receipt Printing | Shop Tutorial
videos.description:
Step-by-step interactive tutorial for cashiers:
1. Select items from categories.
2. Apply discounts and adjust quantities.
3. Complete cash payment and print receipt.

videos.title: 02 - Adding Products and Barcodes | Shop Tutorial
videos.description:
Step-by-step interactive tutorial for inventory management:
1. Open Products screen.
2. Enter title, cost, and sales price.
3. Scan barcode and save.
